item.title: Cleanup, damage assessment begins in Philadelphia after snowstorm
item.description: City officials say the storm's effects on Philadelphia's tree canopy could continue well beyond the winter.

item.title: Philadelphia man charged with murdering wife in Rockledge, Pa.
item.description: According to court documents, Jose Luna told investigators that he and his wife had been at a party earlier in the day and that he became angry because she "disrespected him in front of others."

item.title: AccuWeather: Watch for refreeze overnight
item.description: Any slush or standing water on untreated surfaces will turn icy as temperatures drop into the 20s.

item.title: Coast Guard commandant condemns hate after swastika at Training Center Cape May
item.description: The United States Coast Guard is investigating after a swastika was found at its training center in Cape May.

item.title: US women's gold medal-winning team declines invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey gold medal-winning team has politely declined an invitation from President Donald Trump to attend his State of the Union address on Tuesday.

item.title: Winter storm knocks out power to thousands across Camden County, NJ
item.description: Atlantic City Electric reported that 112,000 customers lost power during the storm, including about 9,000 in Camden County.

item.title: Latest snow totals after winter storm slams Philadelphia region
item.description: The winter storm buried the Philadelphia region in more than a foot of snow in some areas.

item.title: Winter storm cleanup continues in Delaware
item.description: Nearly all of the major roads traveled in New Castle County were free of snow or slush, despite most of the county receiving between 7 and 12 inches of snow overnight and into the morning.

item.title: Aisha Dee reveals all about her Hulu series 'Watching You'
item.description: "It affects you in a way that's really unexpected." Aisha Dee unpacks the drama in "Watching You." The psychological thriller is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Robert Carradine, 'Revenge of the Nerds' and 'Lizzie McGuire' actor, dies at 71
item.description: Robert Carradine, the actor known for his roles in "Revenge of the Nerds" and "Lizzie McGuire," has died at the age of 71.
